tools.description: List cannabis growers and distributors certified under OCal, California's comparable-to-organic standard, from the state's own list, with links to their TerraVault license pages where the name matches. Optional city or county filter. California only.

tools.description: Count the active cannabis licenses on one state's list, by license type, with the date the list was last read and the state agency that publishes it.
